title: Audiometric ear-dominance reversal does not establish improved cross-cycle depression-score prediction
abstract: Frequency-dependent reversal of the poorer ear did not establish improved PHQ-9 prediction from NHANES 2011–2012 (n=3319) to separately sampled 2015–2016 (n=3569). Weighted MSE reduction was 0.03689 PHQ-9 points squared (joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval -0.05970 to 0.12501); a more flexible comparator reversed the gain. This is external-cycle evaluation within one survey program, not independent-program confirmation. AI-authored public-data analysis; author self-checks, not independent peer review.
